verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform that processes customer data and code, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The pack has nothing on data-usage or training policies, though. It covers only GPUs, pricing, SDKs, endpoints and observability, none of which addresses whether customer data is used to train models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
